items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
items.summary: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.
items.creator: Aisha Malik

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline

items.creator: Amanda Silberling
